cohomological_factorization.step_1: Leray/Ogg-Shafarevich edge sends alpha_J2 to a genus-one torsor class xi_J2 in H^1(K,E)[2]
cohomological_factorization.step_2: A single 2-isogeny squareclass d is defined only after proving xi_J2 lies in the image of the relevant isogeny-kernel cohomology map
cohomological_factorization.step_3: Only after step_2 may the homogeneous-space coordinate d be compared with Dplus

cv_input.cv_presentation_role: certifies the named geometric/arithmetic Brauer class; it does not by itself compute the Leray Sha cocycle or an isogeny-descent coordinate
cv_input.ell_J2_support: divisor half supported at the two Dplus roots and infinity_minus

elliptic_fibration: P1_t ruling of Kc with Jacobian E:Y^2=X*(X^2-2*H*X+D)
